title: Sanmilan Prabandhabali Vol. 1: Early Essays on the Antiquities, Peoples and Languages of Assam
author: Asam Chhatra Sanmilan (আসাম ছাত্ৰ সন্মিলন)
description: Historical collection of early collegiate essays read at the foundational session of Asam Chhatra Sanmilan in Guwahati (1916). It features pioneering research papers examining the Tai-Ahom and Nora migrations across the Patkai, the ancient ruins of Pragjyotisha, tribal philology, and the preservation of sanchipat manuscripts.
